description: Create a vinyl record collection tracker spreadsheet. Parse unstructured purchase notes from /home/ga/Documents/record_notes.txt containing 10 vinyl records. Create a spreadsheet with columns: Album Title, Artist, Purchase Date, Purchase Source, Purchase Price, Condition, Estimated Current Value, Profit/Loss, and ROI %. Add formulas to calculate profit/loss and ROI percentage for each record. Create a summary section with total invested, current collection value, overall profit/loss, and average ROI. Apply formatting: bold headers, currency formatting for prices, percentage formatting for ROI, and background color on headers. Save as /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/vinyl_collection.xlsx
